docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The second part of the Chāndogya Upaniṣad with the commentary of Śaṅkarācārya, in Ganganatha Jha's English translation, volume 4 of the Madras edition (V. C. Seshacharri, 1899).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Digitised by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts / Archaeological Survey of India; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Upanishads and Sri Sankaraʼs commentary vol.4 · Sastri, Sitaram · 1899, 398 scanned pages. Published 1899; the translator Ganganatha Jha died 1941; public domain in India.

The scans of this book are not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page was read from the scan by machine (OCR) for this library, and lightly cleaned; it may contain errors, and the scan of every page is one button away.
